text:
leah: Quick sync — coordinating canary toggles for model v4.1 rollout. Plan is percent-based + region gating: NA first, then EU, then APAC. Need owners for flips, guardrails, and clear rollback commands. Who can take which region?

ben: I can own EU flips. prefer to do them during our 9am-5pm PT window.

carlos: Add a tier allowlist flag so customers on enterprise SKUs don't get the canary until we opt them in. Suggest key: ff:model_v4_1_tier_allowlist.

maya: Monitoring checklist: p50/p95 latency, 5xx error rate, prompt/response token cost drift, and eval-probe quality checks (small prompt set). Pager if error-rate spikes >0.5% sustained over 3m or p95 latency >200ms over 2m. Also metric: regen-rate on long tails.

rachel: I can build the Datadog dashboard and wire the alerts. Need the exact flag names and the query tags we'll emit.

leah: Flag keys I propose:
- ff:model_v4_1_global_percent  (0-100)
- ff:model_v4_1_regions         (csv: na,eu,apac)
- ff:model_v4_1_kill_switch     (bool — immediate fallback to v4.0)
- ff:model_v4_1_internal_only   (bool — internal traffic only)
- ff:model_v4_1_tier_allowlist  (list of account ids / tiers)

ben: Ramp cadence suggestion: 1% -> 5% after 30m stable -> 20% after 1h stable -> 100% after 24h stable. Start NA at 1% internal_only soak for first 2h before public percent.

alex: Make sure caching prefixes and sticky session routing won't bias the sample. We should include a warmup request pattern to populate KV caches for each shard. Also confirm autoscale config: +30% headroom for canary.

maya: Playbook notes: if品質 (quality) eval probes show >2% regression vs baseline on the probe set, trigger manual hold and notify ML-ops. If cost per 1k tokens increases >20% vs baseline, hold and investigate.

leah: Revert/runbook commands (keep handy):
```
# kill switch (turn on to immediate rollback)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  https://admin.internal/api/flags/ff:model_v4_1_kill_switch 
  -d '{"enabled": true}'

# set percent to 0
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/flags/ff:model_v4_1_global_percent -d '{"value":0}'

# restart serving if we need a hard reset
kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-serving -n redwood
```

ben: I'll be on-call for EU flips. @oncall please hold daytime standby for day 2 full rollout.

oncall: I'm on standby for day 2 window.

rachel: PR for the infra toggle wiring: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/412 — requesting quick review, aim to merge before noon PT tomorrow.

leah: Assignments: leah -> NA initial flips + dashboards; ben -> EU; maya -> APAC + quality checks; rachel -> dashboards & alerts; carlos -> tier allowlist. Approvals needed from infra and security.

ben: LGTM from my side, left a couple of tiny comments on the PR.

rachel: Will add the alert runbook snippets and link to the pager.

leah: Great — I'll post a final schedule once the PR merges. Please thumbs-up here if you prefer a slightly different cadence. :thumbsup:
